passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: L. DEBT Revolving Credit Facility On May 1, 2020, Teradyne entered into a credit agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) with Truist Bank, as administrative agent and collateral agent, and the lenders party thereto. The Credit Agreement provides for a three-year , senior secured revolving credit facility of $ 400.0 million (the “Credit Facility”). On December 10, 2021, the Credit Agreement was amended to extend the maturity date of the Credit Facility to December 10, 2026. On October 5, 2022, the Credit Agreement was amended to increase the amount of the Credit Facility to $ 750.0 million from $ 400.0 million. On November 7, 2023, the Credit Agreement was amended to allow for the purchase of the shares of Technoprobe. The Credit Agreement provides that, subject to customary conditions, Teradyne may seek to obtain from existing or new lenders the available incremental amount under the Credit Facility, not to exceed the greater of $ 200.0 million or 15 % of consolidated EBIDTA. The interest rate applicable to loans under the Credit Facility are, at Teradyne’s option, equal to either a base rate plus a margin ranging from 0.00 % to 0.75 % per annum or SOFR plus a margin ranging from 1.10 % to 1.85 % per annum, based on the consolidated leverage ratio of Teradyne. In addition, Teradyne will pay a commitment fee on the unused portion of the commitments under the Credit Facility ranging from 0.15 % to 0.25 % per annum, based on the then applicable consolidated leverage ratio. Teradyne is not required to repay any loans under the Credit Facility prior to maturity, subject to certain customary exceptions. Teradyne is permitted to prepay all or any portion of the loans under the Credit Facility prior to maturity without premium or penalty, other than customary SOFR breakage costs. The Credit Agreement contains customary events of default, representations, warranties and affirmative and negative covenants that, among other things, limit Teradyne’s ability to sell assets, grant liens on assets, incur other secured indebtedness and make certain investments and restricted payments, all subject to exceptions set forth in the Credit Agreement. The Credit Agreement also requires Teradyne to satisfy two financial ratios measured as of the end of each fiscal quarter; a consolidated leverage ratio and an interest coverage ratio. The Credit Facility is guaranteed by certain of Teradyne’s domestic subsidiaries and collateralized by assets of Teradyne and such subsidiaries, including a pledge of 65 % of the capital stock of certain foreign subsidiaries.

credit_strengths.text: Teradyne's gross leverage sits well below the sector median, reflecting a debt-light balance sheet against a substantial EBITDA proxy. The indicative financial risk profile is Minimal on a net-cash basis, giving wide headroom to covenant thresholds disclosed in the credit agreement.

Interest coverage is far above the sector median and comfortably exceeds unity, with operating income dwarfing gross interest expense. Free cash flow to debt also exceeds the sector median, underscoring strong cash generation relative to a modest borrowing base.

key_risks.text: Shareholder distributions absorb more than operating cash flow, with buybacks alone exceeding operating cash flow and free cash flow covering only part of buybacks. Sustained repurchases at this pace would draw on the cash buffer rather than internally generated funds.

The revolving credit facility matures in the near term and is secured by domestic assets plus a pledge of foreign subsidiary stock, with financial covenant tests on leverage and interest coverage. Refinancing or extension risk is modest but the secured, covenant-bearing structure limits flexibility if conditions tighten.

The risk factors passage flags forward-looking uncertainties across Teradyne's semiconductor test and robotics end markets, where demand is cyclical and concentrated in consumer electronics and industrial capital spending. Revenue durability, not leverage, is the binding credit variable for this issuer.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure and dividends with a wide margin, and free cash flow covers dividends several times over. Debt service is therefore comfortably funded from recurring operations, though the buyback program consumes the surplus.

The current ratio exceeds the sector median and stands above unity, supported by a cash balance that exceeds reported borrowings. Liquidity is adequate to meet near-term maturities without reliance on external funding.

overall_credit_view.text: Teradyne presents a Minimal indicative financial risk profile: net cash, leverage below the sector median and coverage far above peer levels. The credit story rests on cash generation and a liquid balance sheet rather than on debt capacity, consistent with the automated test and robotics franchise described in the filing.

Our forward view is that distributions, not debt, are the key swing factor; if buybacks continue above free cash flow, the net cash position erodes. We would monitor the revolver renewal and covenant compliance, while treating cyclical end-market demand as the principal earnings risk.

credit_strengths.text: Teradyne 的總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，反映其負債輕的資產負債表相對於可觀的 EBITDA 代理指標。按淨現金基準計算，指示性財務風險狀況為極低，為信貸協議中披露的契約門檻提供充裕的緩衝空間。
利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，並穩妥地超過一，營業收入遠超總利息支出。自由現金流對債務比率亦高於行業中位數，突顯相對於適度借款基礎的強勁現金生成能力。

key_risks.text: 股東分派吸收超過經營現金流，單是回購已超過經營現金流，而自由現金流不足以全數覆蓋回購。若以此速度持續回購，將動用現金緩衝而非內部產生的資金。
循環信貸融資於短期內到期，並以境內資產加上外國附屬公司股份質押作為擔保，附有槓桿及利息覆蓋的財務契約測試。再融資或延期風險適度，但該有擔保、附帶契約的結構在條件收緊時限制靈活性。
風險因素章節標示 Teradyne 半導體測試及機器人終端市場的前瞻性不確定因素，該等市場需求具週期性，並集中於消費電子及工業資本支出。收入持久性而非槓桿，是此發行人的關鍵信貸變數。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流以寬裕幅度覆蓋資本支出及股息，自由現金流覆蓋股息數倍。因此債務償付由經常性營運舒適地提供資金，儘管回購計劃消耗盈餘。
流動比率高於行業中位數並高於一，受惠於現金餘額超過呈報借款。流動性足以應付短期到期債務，無需依賴外部融資。

overall_credit_view.text: Teradyne 呈現極低的指示性財務風險狀況：淨現金、槓桿低於行業中位數，覆蓋率遠高於同業水平。信貸故事建基於現金生成及流動的資產負債表，而非債務容量，與申報文件中所述的自動化測試及機器人業務相符。
我們的前瞻觀點是，分派而非債務是關鍵的擺動因素；若回購持續超過自由現金流，淨現金狀況將受侵蝕。我們將監察循環信貸續期及契約合規情況，同時將週期性終端市場需求視為主要盈利風險。
